english.title: Supply unclassified video recording
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) supplied a video recording containing a video work, namely **(..SPECIFY VIDEO..), in respect of which no classification has been issued
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(1) and (3) of the Video Recordings Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
supplied video recording with no classification

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 9(1) and (2) for exemptions and defences and sections 2 and 3 for definitions of "exempted work" and "exempted supply".
(ii) See sections 16A and 16B for extended powers of enforcing authorities and extended jurisdiction of magistrates' courts.
(iii) See also the associated offence wording as follows: H1984.

other.powersofarrest: Although normally prosecuted by the trading standards dept., If a constable has reasonable grounds for suspecting that a person has committed this offence, he may require him to give his name and address and, if that person refuses or fails to do so, or gives a name and address which the constable reasonably suspects to be false, the constable may arrest him without warrant (section 18).
other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding twenty thousand pounds.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
